entries.name: Hex Volley
entries.rationale: Interrupt the Risen Hexer group cast; remove any Curse that lands after a missed stop.

entries.name: Bind Soul
entries.rationale: A named priority interrupt from Queen Wasi.

entries.name: Unholy Mending
entries.rationale: Interrupt Seneschal M'bara's heal; purge its Magic effect if the cast completes.

entries.name: Wretched Discharge
entries.rationale: Stop the Half-Finished Mummy cast; cleanse the Disease as recovery if it lands.

entries.name: Hex
entries.rationale: Interrupt the Phantom Hex Priest; remove the Curse only after a failed stop.

entries.name: Poison Nova
entries.rationale: Interrupt Zanazal's large AoE; cleanse Poison applications if the cast succeeds.

entries.name: Deathly Roar
entries.rationale: Stop Reban's AoE fear during Dazar.

entries.name: Bound by Shadow
entries.rationale: Purge the Minion of Zul shield to kill the minion immediately instead of breaking it through damage.

entries.name: Ancestral Fury
entries.rationale: Remove the Shadow-Borne Champion's Enrage to reduce its pressure.

entries.name: Bestial Berserk
entries.rationale: Remove Queen Patlaa's Enrage effect from the hunting raptors.

entries.name: Captain's Bulwark
entries.rationale: Offensively remove Guard Captain Atu's Magic bulwark.

entries.name: Putrid Seekers
entries.rationale: Cleanse the Poison applied by Embalming Fluid.

provenance.description: Current interrupt, dispel, purge, Enrage-removal, and boss priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Midnight Season 2 dungeon overview.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, dispel types, and Enrage flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
